title: 本周自练 · 教练休假周
intro: 教练这周不在，自己练 3 次：周一推 + 核心，周三拉 + 腿，周五肩臂 + 核心。除了热身里的弹力带肩外旋，全部动作都是前六节课学过的。每次约 55 分钟，组间休息 60 到 90 秒，大部分组留 2 次余力。
intro_en: The trainer is away this week, so three self sessions: Monday push + core, Wednesday pull + legs, Friday shoulders, arms + core. Apart from the band external rotation in the warm-up, every exercise was learned in the first six sessions. About 55 minutes each, 60 to 90 seconds between sets, leave 2 reps in reserve on most sets.
rationale: 上肢为主，胸一周练两次：周一 10 组（卧推、双杠、飞鸟），周五 5 组（上斜卧推、俯卧撑）。腿只在周三集中练一次，核心每次都有。
第 6 节后胸肌酸痛明显、三头和背的酸痛比第 4 节轻，说明胸的刺激到位、三头和背已经在适应。所以本周胸保持量，拉的强度再往上走一点。
辅助引体和双杠从 70 lb 继续往下减 5 lb；卧推从 20 lb 起，最后一组试 25 lb。
周三和周日有羽毛球，所以腿放周三中午、量适中，周五不练腿。
三次之间各隔一天，推和拉分开，肩臂放最后一天，肌肉有恢复时间。
周一、周五热身里各加 2 组弹力带肩外旋，很轻，保护肩袖。这是唯一的新动作，简单到看一眼就会。
rationale_en: Upper body first, chest twice a week: 10 sets Monday (bench, dips, flyes) and 5 Friday (incline press, push-ups). Legs get one focused block on Wednesday; core appears every day.

After session 6 the chest was clearly sore while triceps and back were less sore than after session 4: chest stimulus is landing, triceps and back are adapting. So chest volume holds this week and pulling intensity edges up.
Assisted pull-ups and dips drop another 5 lb from 70; the bench starts at 20 lb with 25 lb on the last set.
Badminton falls on Wednesday and Sunday, so legs go in Wednesday's noon session at moderate volume and Friday has none.
A day between each session, push and pull on separate days, shoulders and arms last, so each muscle gets recovery time.
Monday and Friday warm-ups each add 2 light sets of band external rotation to protect the rotator cuff. It is the only new move and trivial to learn.

items: 每次练完把实际重量和次数告诉 Claude，三次都会变成自练记录。
哪次练完哪里最酸、哪里不酸，也告诉我，下周的计划据此调整。
肩前侧在双杠或推举时有刺痛就停，换成俯卧撑或卧推。
练后午饭先吃碳水和蛋白质。
items_en: After each session tell Claude the actual weights and reps; all three become self-session logs.
Also tell me where you were sore and where you were not; next week's plan adjusts to that.
Sharp pain at the front of the shoulder on dips or presses means stop and swap to push-ups or bench.
Post-workout lunch: carbs and protein first.

sessions.title: 推 + 核心 · 胸优先
sessions.goal: 卧推、辅助双杠、哑铃飞鸟共 10 组胸，然后核心三个动作。上斜卧推挪到周五，让胸一周练两次。
sessions.goal_en: 10 chest sets across bench, assisted dips and dumbbell flyes, then three core moves. Incline press moves to Friday so the chest gets two sessions a week.

items.how: 肘贴肋，只转前臂，很轻就对了。
items.how_en: Elbow pinned to the ribs, only the forearm turns; it should feel light.

items.how: 慢速，当卧推热身。
items.how_en: Slow tempo, as a warm-up for the bench.

items.target: 每手 20 lb，第 4 组 25 lb
items.target_en: 20 lb per hand, 25 lb on set 4
items.how: 第 6 节 20 lb × 10 × 4。前 3 组 20 lb，第 3 组还能多做 3 次就第 4 组换 25 lb。
items.how_en: Session 6 was 4 × 10 at 20 lb. First three sets at 20 lb; if set 3 leaves 3 reps in the tank, take 25 lb for set 4.

blocks.name: 第二组 · 推 + 飞鸟（超级组）
blocks.rest: 两个连做，然后休息 90 秒
blocks.rest_en: back to back, then rest 90 seconds

items.how: 第 6 节 70 lb × 10 × 4。今天减到 65 lb 做 3 × 10，上身略前倾练胸。做不到 10 个就回 70 lb。
items.how_en: Session 6 was 4 × 10 at 70 lb. Drop to 65 lb for 3 × 10, lean slightly forward for the chest. If 10 is not there, go back to 70 lb.

items.how: 第 5 节 15 lb × 10-12。肘微弯固定，像抱树，下到胸口有拉伸感就停，3 秒下 1 秒上。12 个轻松也先不加重量，加慢速。
items.how_en: Session 5 was 15 lb × 10-12. Slight fixed bend in the elbows, like hugging a tree; stop when the chest feels the stretch, 3 seconds down and 1 up. If 12 is easy, slow the tempo before adding weight.

items.how: 下背压地，放到快碰地停住。
items.how_en: Lower back pressed down; stop just above the floor.

items.how: 第 6 节 10 秒，今天 15 秒。
items.how_en: Session 6 was 10 s; today 15 s.

items.how: 手撑凳上做到做不动，记次数。
items.how_en: Hands on the bench, to failure; write down the reps.

sessions.title: 拉 + 腿
sessions.goal: 辅助引体和单臂划船共 7 组拉，然后深蹲、硬拉、弓步各一轮，最后臀和二头。
sessions.goal_en: 7 pulling sets across assisted pull-ups and single-arm rows, then one round each of squat, hinge and lunge, finishing with glutes and biceps.

items.how: 第 6 节 70 lb × 10 × 4。今天 65 lb 做 4 × 8，下巴过杆，下放 3 秒。做不到 8 个就回 70 lb。
items.how_en: Session 6 was 4 × 10 at 70 lb. Today 65 lb for 4 × 8, chin over the bar, 3-second lowering. If 8 is not there, go back to 70 lb.

items.how: 第 5 节 30 lb × 10。背平、肘贴身拉到髋。轻松就下次 35 lb。
items.how_en: Session 5 was 30 lb × 10. Flat back, elbow close, pull to the hip. If easy, 35 lb next time.

items.how: 第 3、5 节都是 30 lb。10 个轻松就第 3 组换 35 lb。
items.how_en: Sessions 3 and 5 were 30 lb. If 10 is easy, take 35 lb for set 3.

items.how: 膝微弯不动，屁股向后推。
items.how_en: Knees slightly bent and still; push the hips back.

items.how: 晚上有羽毛球，只做 2 组。
items.how_en: Badminton tonight, so only 2 sets.

blocks.name: 第三组 · 臀 + 二头

items.how: 第 2 节没记重量，先 15 lb 试一组；弯举推举用过 10 lb，纯弯举可以重一点。
items.how_en: Session 2 had no weight logged; try 15 lb for a set. You used 10 lb on curl-to-press, and a plain curl can go heavier.

items.how: 放松髋和腘绳，为晚上羽毛球留活动度。
items.how_en: Loosens hips and hamstrings for badminton tonight.

sessions.title: 肩臂 + 核心
sessions.goal: 上斜卧推给胸第二次刺激，推举和弯举推举练肩臂，TRX 划船和过头臂屈伸补平衡，负重行走和 Pallof 推练核心，最后俯卧撑测试。
sessions.goal_en: Incline press gives the chest its second hit of the week; presses and curl-to-press for shoulders and arms, TRX rows and overhead triceps for balance, loaded carries and Pallof press for core, ending with the push-up test.

blocks.name: 第一组 · 上胸 + 肩

items.how: 第 4 节 15 lb × 8。凳子 15 到 30 度，大臂和躯干约 45 到 60 度，别水平开肘。10 个轻松就下次 20 lb。
items.how_en: Session 4 was 15 lb × 8. Bench at 15 to 30 degrees, upper arms about 45 to 60 degrees from the torso, no flaring to 90. If 10 is easy, 20 lb next time.

items.how: 第 5 节 15 lb × 10。第 3 组还有余力就换 20 lb。
items.how_en: Session 5 was 15 lb × 10. If set 3 has room, take 20 lb.

items.how: 第 6 节 10 lb × 10 × 4。弯举到肩、翻腕、推过头。
items.how_en: Session 6 was 4 × 10 at 10 lb. Curl to the shoulder, turn the wrists, press overhead.

blocks.name: 第二组 · 拉 + 三头（超级组）
blocks.rest: 两个连做，然后休息 60 秒
blocks.rest_en: back to back, then rest 60 seconds

items.how: 脚往前挪让 12 个刚好吃力。
items.how_en: Walk the feet forward until 12 is hard.

items.how: 第 5 节 15 lb × 10-15。肘夹紧指向前上，只动前臂。
items.how_en: Session 5 was 15 lb × 10-15. Elbows tight and pointing forward-up; only the forearms move.

blocks.name: 第三组 · 核心 + 负重行走

items.how: 课上一直是 40 lb。稳就试 45 lb。
items.how_en: Always 40 lb in class. If steady, try 45 lb.

items.how: 第 4 节没记重量，30 lb 起。躯干别向负重侧倾。
items.how_en: No weight logged in session 4; start at 30 lb. Do not lean toward the weight.

items.target_en: lightest pin you can hold square

items.how: 俯卧撑 20 个里程碑的测试，记次数。
items.how_en: The 20 push-up milestone test; write down the reps.
